scenes.text: I see a person on a boat. I heard a small whistle in the air. I said “oh no let’s get out of here”. My legs were shaking , the wind wasn’t strong either. I quickly rushed home with my mate.

The school bus pass away without me. I am very sad. I go to my mom and dad. They say that I need to go to school myself, but it was 10 KM away. So they drove me there when we arrived. It was very hard because the rain is pouring. Then I said.”thank you I will tell the office”.
